items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: The new personnel was given as: Syd Valentine, Red Harland, Sprat Morton, playing trumpets.

ctx.x: Sprat Morton. Sprat Morton -- maybe a lot of people don't know --he was a nice trumpet

player from Louisville, Kentucky, He had nanny in his... a little (unintelligible), but he could read. He had a little shake in his tone. But the main thing was a lot of people don't know that he was the husband of a great singer, Helen Humes.
